title: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis
author: 宏亮 董
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7h3hj8n

steps.title: Prepare 1X TAE solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 50X TAE to make 1X TAE and add 20 mL of this 1X TAE to the gel mixture.

steps.title: Heat gel solution
steps.instruction: Heat the mixture until the solution becomes homogeneous.

steps.title: Add GelRed stain
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL GelRed to the solution and mix well.

steps.title: Cast the agarose gel
steps.instruction: Pour the solution into the casting tray, place the comb correctly, and ensure the solution is level and balanced.

substeps.instruction: Pour the solution into the gel casting tray.
Insert the comb, making sure it is properly positioned.
Verify that the solution is balanced and level before polymerization.
